5742.title: [M156] Integrate mask-filtered glyph hardening
5742.body:
[M156] Integrate mask-filtered glyph hardening (#5742)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/454
Changes: https://github.com/mono/skia/compare/712ea097151d4951652dee046a8944376fd8df1b...34fd542cf1ef15e3f76c90c3db96d227186af0ce

Advance externals/skia and its cgmanifest registration to the merged
release/4.156.x native commit
34fd542cf1ef15e3f76c90c3db96d227186af0ce, integrating chrome/m156 through
4c5f57e4fa037da858ef66420903d5734fd6b363.

Adopt SkScalerContext::getImage hardening for consecutive glyph loads
that disagree about paths, mask formats, or bounds. The native change
uses the reloaded glyph's path, restricts overlap copies to matching
byte-per-pixel masks, and preserves full plane strides when clipping
embossed glyphs. This avoids stale-path rendering, sub-byte buffer
overwrites, and corrupted or uncleared 3D mask planes.

Record the upstream revision in cgmanifest alongside the actual fork
merge SHA. The native merge directly contains the reviewed head and has
the identical tree, so the final repin preserves the reviewed code.
This servicing update changes neither managed bindings nor release-line
version declarations.

5724.title: Fix OpenJDK validation with JVM diagnostics and task retries
5724.body:
Match javac's version at the start of any output line so JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS diagnostics do not reject a valid JDK. Keep exit-code and requested-major validation unchanged, and overwrite archive files on retry after a complete or partial extraction.


(cherry picked from commit dd9cc6cb21782647b4948894a983f7ccaff97f6d)
